label: copy-phase input r (or y) near the end of the copy
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99% of mass) at steps where the fed-back input is r (72% of mass) or y (24%), with a few on x. Most activations are in the last ~3 copy steps (to_go 0-2, 86% of mass), and short sequences (L = 3-4) are over-represented. Activity is enriched when the token being output is r, f, z, c, s or x. It does not fire in the original phase (except ~1%) or at the delimiter, and almost never on any other input token. The predicate covers ~82% of activations and mass but has only ~1% precision, because the feature fires on a tiny fraction of the r/y copy steps. Adding out_tok or L conditions raised precision to at most ~12% and cost a lot of recall, so what selects the firing subset is unresolved. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.12, max 0.22); the largest activations are on input r in short sequences.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=r (+5.50), t=3 & prev_tok=o (+5.32), phase=2 & in_tok=y (+4.13), phase=2 & out_tok=f (+3.94), phase=2 & out_tok=z (+3.36), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=x (+3.12). Lower it: to_go=6 (-2.47), orig5=l (-2.24), next_out=u (-2.21), prev_tok=3 (-1.94).
